TerryXuMemoryCleanup.description: Clean this ComfyUI process's RAM and optionally unload models and VRAM cache, while preserving any input type or ComfyUI List.

TerryXuGroupManager.description: Manually select workflow groups and independently enable or bypass the nodes inside each group.

TerryXuLinkedBoolean.description: Create or select a linked channel. Nodes on the same channel share one BOOLEAN state; toggling any member synchronizes the others. This system is independent of Remote Control.

TerryXuH3PromptEditor.description: Visual MiniMax H3 prompt editor with dynamic image, video and audio references. Use @ for media and / for H3 syntax commands; output is always standard H3 STRING text.

visual_preview.name: Visual Preview
visual_preview.tooltip: On: visualize tags. Off: show raw H3 text.

TerryXuWirelessBusPack.description: Publish multiple connections to an independent TerryXu wireless bus channel.

TerryXuWirelessBusUnpack.description: Select a TerryXu wireless bus channel and restore all of its connections.

TerryXuLineSwitch.description: Select a route by index or external INT control.

TerryXuBoolSwitch.description: Select between two inputs with a Boolean control.

TerryXuRemoteControl.description: Control linked switches and routing via a selected channel.

TerryXuMediaLoader.description: Manage image, audio and video assets and expose an ordered bus.

TerryXuMediaBusItem.description: Internal asset decoder for Media Loader.

TerryXuBusToList.description: Expand a media or wireless bus to an ordered ComfyUI list.
